rename-workspace-to-pr-title.title: Rename Workspace to PR Title
rename-workspace-to-pr-title.subtitle: Clipboard PR URL first, else the current branch PR
rename-workspace-to-pr-title.command: c=$(pbpaste 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in https://github.com/*/pull/*) t=$(command gh pr view "$c" --json title -q .title 2>/dev/null) ;; *) t=$(command gh pr view --json title -q .title 2>/dev/null) ;; esac; if [ -n "$t" ]; then "${CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH:-cmux}" workspace rename --workspace "$CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID" --title "$t"; else echo 'no PR found (copy a GitHub PR URL, or run from a branch that has an open PR)'; fi
